title: Error count under the addressing flip
statement: Let $m$ be a natural number and let $g$ be a Boolean function on the sign cube with $m+2^m$ coordinates. The sum, over all inputs, of the error indicator comparing the addressing function with $g$ after applying the addressing flip equals the corresponding error-indicator sum before the flip.
hypotheses_covered: $g$ is a Boolean function on the sign cube with $m+2^m$ coordinates
